type: in-place transform edit (+0x24 position, +0x34 heading, +0xB8 scale) of a placement record in a level other than the tutorial
structure: The placement class is detected structurally per file (igz.types.per-file-indices) and carries the same fields on all 76 level archives (igz.placement.type104-record: 43 258 placements, 100% schema-valid). The editor writes the same three attributes at the same offsets on every level; a save changes exactly the authorised words and nothing else. On Level_000_Mining the placement class is index 98 and Lantern_01 / Lantern_01(1) (Mine_Lantern.mdl, Lantern_Generic.ai) sit at (84.9, 16.1, -37) and (82.4, 16.0, -54.3), in the opening camera's view.
meaning: The game reads the edited position of a placement on a level other than the tutorial: lowering Mining's two opening-scene lanterns by 5 units through the editor's own path (open by name, transform, save, patch, direct launch through the archive redirect) removes the lantern from the top-left of the opening captures and puts its glow lower on the left edge, identically on two cold boots of a byte-identical patch. Confirmed on Mining; with the tutorial that is two levels, the record layout is validated on all 76, so transforms are offered everywhere, CONFIRMED only for the levels listed in confirmed_levels, whose edited transforms were tested, and LIKELY elsewhere. The entry matrix proves reaching a level, not the effect of an edit. Scripted placements keep their own caveat (level.pushblock.track-dependency): the lanterns' light script did not object, push blocks did on the tutorial. Duplication still needs a runtime map per level.
